WITH principal_lower_gi AS (
  -- principal diagnoses (seq_num = 1) that likely indicate lower GI bleeding
  SELECT
    d.subject_id,
    d.hadm_id,
    d.icd_code,
    dd.long_title
  FROM
    `kltn-text-to-sql.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.diagnoses_icd` d
  LEFT JOIN
    `kltn-text-to-sql.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.d_icd_diagnoses` dd
  ON
    d.icd_code = dd.icd_code
  WHERE
    d.seq_num = 1
    AND (
      -- common keyword patterns for lower GI bleeding / hematochezia / rectal bleeding
      (LOWER(COALESCE(dd.long_title, '')) LIKE '%lower%' AND LOWER(COALESCE(dd.long_title, '')) LIKE '%gastrointestinal%')
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(dd.long_title, '')) LIKE '%hematochezia%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(dd.long_title, '')) LIKE '%rectal%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(dd.long_title, '')) LIKE '%rectal bleeding%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(dd.long_title, '')) LIKE '%lower gi bleed%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(dd.long_title, '')) LIKE '%lower gi hemorrhage%'
    )
),
cohort AS (
  -- Index admissions that meet demographic, payer, ED source, and principal DX criteria
  SELECT
    a.subject_id,
    a.hadm_id,
    a.admittime,
    a.dischtime,
    a.admission_type,
    a.admission_location,
    a.insurance,
    p.gender,
    p.anchor_age,
    -- LOS in fractional days
    SAFE_DIVIDE(DATETIME_DIFF(a.dischtime, a.admittime, SECOND), 86400.0) AS los_days
  FROM
    `kltn-text-to-sql.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.admissions` a
  INNER JOIN
    `kltn-text-to-sql.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.patients` p
  ON
    a.subject_id = p.subject_id
  INNER JOIN
    principal_lower_gi plg
  ON
    a.hadm_id = plg.hadm_id
  WHERE
    p.gender = 'M'
    AND p.anchor_age BETWEEN 50 AND 60
    AND UPPER(COALESCE(a.insurance, '')) LIKE '%MEDICARE%'
    AND a.edregtime IS NOT NULL    -- admitted from ED
    AND COALESCE(a.hospital_expire_flag, 0) = 0  -- exclude in-hospital deaths
),
readmit_flags AS (
  -- For each index admission, determine whether there is a readmission within 30 days
  SELECT
    c.*,
    CASE WHEN MIN(r.admittime) IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS readmitted_30d
  FROM
    cohort c
  LEFT JOIN
    `kltn-text-to-sql.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.admissions` r
  ON
    c.subject_id = r.subject_id
    AND r.hadm_id != c.hadm_id
    AND r.admittime > c.dischtime
    AND r.admittime <= DATETIME_ADD(c.dischtime, INTERVAL 30 DAY)
  GROUP BY
    c.subject_id, c.hadm_id, c.admittime, c.dischtime, c.admission_type, c.admission_location, c.insurance, c.gender, c.anchor_age, c.los_days
)
SELECT
  -- Overall 30-day readmission rate for the cohort
  COUNT(*) AS total_index_admissions,
  SUM(readmitted_30d) AS total_readmitted_30d,
  ROUND(100.0 * SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(readmitted_30d), COUNT(*)), 2) AS readmission_rate_pct_30d,
  -- Per-group statistics: readmitted vs not readmitted
  rf.readmitted_30d AS readmitted_flag,
  COUNT(*) AS n_admissions,
  -- median LOS using APPROX_QUANTILES (median ~ 0.5 quantile)
  (APPROX_QUANTILES(rf.los_days, 2))[OFFSET(1)] AS median_los_days,
  ROUND(100.0 * SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN rf.los_days > 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), COUNT(*)), 2) AS pct_los_gt_6
FROM
  readmit_flags rf
GROUP BY
  rf.readmitted_30d
ORDER BY
  rf.readmitted_30d DESC;
